scope: original same-master50 households and500 cases only
evidence: EB family heat-pump always_avail and thermostat schedules provide continuous-thermostat capability;the following room routines are explicit benchmark scenario assumptions,not measured household behavior or inferred preferences

room_modes.combined_bed_living: home_continuous: maintain thermostat through household home periods,including sleep and kitchen/bathroom activities
room_modes.living_day_room: awake_home_continuous: maintain through household awake-at-home episodes,regardless of which room people temporarily use
room_modes.separate_bedroom: sleep_and_settled_sessions: retain sleep and original comfort coverage,extend from first to last settled room use inside each awake-at-home episode;short domestic excursions do not end a session

circulation: retain original AC fan requests,including the declared daily60min;extended thermostat periods use automatic fan mode. This does not imply daily compressor demand.
setpoints: retain A46 heating/cooling setpoints and deadband;no weather-outcome or price optimization
B: rebase the original B60 executable AC setting changes onto the new common A thermostat routine;retain their exact clocks/settings and non-AC requests,including failures. VPP windows/targets remain the same controlled scenario;actual achievement is re-simulated,not guaranteed.
bedroom_short_absence_refinement: Within a settled home-use session,bridge scheduled brief outside errands too;meal+brief errand is not two unrelated thermostat periods.

sleep_recognition.scope: same semantic sleep state for target members and auxiliary co-residents;all other activity semantics and existing habit thresholds unchanged
sleep_recognition.correction: sleep was formerly excluded only for target calendar label sleep_rest;auxiliary sleep must not count as awake-at-home
